verdicts.reason: A: the white card has come loose from the content and sits empty on the right as a meaningless block. The headline runs into its edge ('FOR' touches it), the poodle is jammed against the left edge, and the bone sits off-axis below the text, so the layout looks broken. B is an unchanged, shrunk copy of the square card centred in the banner, leaving about 75% of the width as dead grey side margins. Its headline and icons are small at banner size, but they stay intact, aligned and free of collisions. It is a lazy shrink, but less broken than A.
